_note: Race photography for the About pages. Added September 10, 2026, when the page was rebuilt from a CV into a memoir. The three photos are laid out as ALTERNATING ROWS in the race chapter — text left / photo right, then photo left / text right, then text left / photo right — and the pairing of a photo to a paragraph lives in each language's template, because the prose does. Only the files and the captions live here. Files: site/assets/images/about/, 1000w + 1400w in jpg and webp, portrait ~2:3. 🚨 CAPTIONS ARE PLACE AND YEAR, NEVER A FINISH TIME. Iván supplied '2h58 PR' with the Buenos Aires photo and it is NOT in that caption: it went into the prose instead, in the same sentence as the 3h30 average, because this page's rule is one ugly number per proud number and a caption is where a proud number goes to stand alone. ⚠️ The Cozumel arch clock in about-finish reads 10:28:02 — that is GUN time on a rolling start, against the 10h06 chip time the prose states. Both are true. Iván to decide whether to crop the clock; flagged September 10, 2026.
